title: ABC Learning Centres Limited - proposed acquisition of 123 Careers Pty Ltd

timeline.event: ACCC commenced review under the Merger Review Process Guidelines.
Closing date for submissions from interested parties.
ACCC announced it would not oppose the proposed acquisition.

body_sections.Summary: ABC Learning Centres Limited proposed to acquire 123 Careers Pty Limited's childcare recruitment business.
body_sections.Market definition: This proposed acquisition was assessed within the context of the following national markets: 1. the supply of child care workers to child care centres (Market 1); and 2. the acquisition of placement services for child care workers (Market 2).
body_sections.Competition analysis: On 24 October 2008, the ACCC formed the view that the proposed acquisition was unlikely to substantially lessen competition in the relevant markets. Factors informing this conclusion included: 1. As 123 Careers supplies its services almost exclusively to its related companies and ABC, the proposed acquisition is unlikely to lead to the removal of a vigorous and effective competitor in either market; 2. Barriers to entry to the relevant markets are low; and 3. There are a number of competitors to 123 Careers in Market 1.
